manual_notes: Issuance implements a hashed, session-bound 10-minute code and exchange handles expiration and same-request retries. However the inspected live-source handler performs separate device insert, token insert and conditional code update with best-effort compensation, whereas the spec requires marking used in the same transaction. An unused RPC migration exists, but its same-request branch also falls through to an exception. Strict full-scope completion is therefore not established; this is not abandonment evidence.
